mapper.insert: insert into tbl_member_setting (id) values (#{memberId}) on conflict (id) do nothing
mapper.select: select p.preference_name from tbl_member_preference mp join tbl_preference p on p.id = mp.preference_id where mp.member_id = #{memberId} order by p.id
select v.vibe_name from tbl_member_vibe mv join tbl_vibe v on v.id = mv.vibe_id where mv.member_id = #{memberId} order by v.id
